params.prompt: Cinematic miniature diorama, heroic armored-tech workshop aesthetic: glossy hot-rod red and gold metal plating with crisp panel lines and rivets, brushed gunmetal accents, warm tungsten garage lighting, subtle cool reactor-glow highlights, tilt-shift miniature photography look, isometric three-quarter aerial view, ultra detailed, empty, unoccupied, no people, architectural model quality. On a plain solid deep warm charcoal background with a soft contact shadow. Palette: hot-rod red #B91C1C, gold #D4A017, gunmetal #3F3F46, reactor glow #7DD3FC, warm white #FAF7F0. No text, no letters, no logos, centered composition. Subject: an armory design lab — drafting desks with unrolled blueprints, a paint bay where an armored suit shell hangs mid-spray in fresh red and gold, a wall of framed artwork posters, a video editing bay with multiple monitors glowing softly.
